text:
Rhea: MonolithCo needs a concise POC acceptance + runplan for procurement. They want clear pass/fail on latency and throughput and a one-line reserved vs burst cost delta.
Sam: their ask: p95 <210ms, p99 <500ms at 190 QPS. i'd suggest we propose p95 <260ms, p99 <680ms to be safe.
Jordi: traffic mix i'll use: 70% short-gen (~35 tokens), 20% long-gen (~140 tokens), 10% embeddings. will upload k6 mix and payloads.
Sam: run config: KV/prefix cache ON, batching=6, prewarm 8m, pin model to rwd-instruct-2.0.
Rhea: proposed runbook:
 - smoke: 10 QPS x 3m
 - ramp: 10 -> 190 QPS over 12m
 - steady: 190 QPS x 30m
 - burst: 380 QPS x 90s x2 (validate graceful degradation)
Command: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 35m monolith_mix.js`
Rhea: metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99, success %, tokens/sec, KV hit %, GPU util, 5xx count, model_version.
Sam: quick internal baseline (informal): p95=170ms p99=390ms @110 QPS on staging with batch=6. labelling as non-prod.
OpsBot: SOC2 and SLA references uploaded to /shared/pocs/monolithco/ :white_check_mark:
Rhea: pricing ballpark for appendix: reserved pool for 190 QPS ~= $17.8k/mo; amortized burst to 380 QPS +~$3.6k/mo. note final depends on avg tokens.
Jordi: acceptance criteria to present:
 - sustain 190 QPS for 30m with success rate >= 99.5%
 - p95 < 260ms, p99 < 680ms
 - no unexpected 5xx during steady window; planned failovers documented
Rhea: i'll send the one-pager + IP CIDR request to their SRE and ask for signed test consent. once we have that, we'll lock a 2hr window and tag ops for execution. :thumbsup:
